subjects.name: Cybersecurity
subjects.description: Core concepts in protecting systems, networks and data.

subjects.name: Artificial Intelligence
subjects.description: Foundations of intelligent systems and machine learning.

topics.title: Cryptography Fundamentals
topics.notes: Cryptography protects information using mathematical transformations. Symmetric systems share one key, while asymmetric systems use a public and private key pair.

topics.title: Network Security
topics.notes: Network security combines access control, monitoring, segmentation, encryption and incident response.

topics.title: Machine Learning Basics
topics.notes: Machine learning systems learn patterns from examples instead of relying only on explicitly programmed rules.

flashcards.question: What is symmetric encryption?
flashcards.answer: Encryption in which the same secret key is used to encrypt and decrypt data.

flashcards.question: What does a cryptographic hash function produce?
flashcards.answer: A fixed-length digest derived from input data.

flashcards.question: What is the main purpose of a firewall?
flashcards.answer: To allow or block network traffic according to security rules.

flashcards.question: What is network segmentation?
flashcards.answer: Dividing a network into smaller isolated sections to reduce access and limit attacks.

flashcards.question: What is supervised learning?
flashcards.answer: Learning a mapping from inputs to known labelled outputs using example data.

flashcards.question: What is overfitting?
flashcards.answer: When a model learns training data too closely and performs poorly on new data.
